findings.reason: an export that drops a kind, the failure the equality is the only guard for, can be landed under a gate that never demonstrates the guard fires; a control that builds one package with a kind's nodes omitted and requires the equality to fail closes it.
findings.text: the per-kind equality "for each kind of node that belongs to the ITER facility, the number in the package equal to the number in the shared graph at the export revision" does not state whether kinds are enumerated from the shared graph or from the package, so a package that silently omits a whole kind satisfies the clause when the enumeration comes from the package; and neither declared control omits a kind — one leaves a foreign facility in and the other switches read-only off — so nothing shows the equality can fail, and the missing-content case it exists for is exactly the one no arm exercises.

findings.reason: adding the empty-result term to the pre-registered private file turns a post-hoc observation into a check that can fail, which is the fix the section already applied to the other two searches.
findings.text: "a search for a term no signal carries returns an explicit empty result" selects its search term by the result it produces: whether a term carries no signal is only knowable from the answers, so a run can pick one that returns empty after the tools have been exercised, and the clause then passes whether or not the empty path is produced deliberately; the change written to fix this same defect for the two positive searches (a private file written before the build, its digest in the landing record) stops one clause short of the third search.
